title: Pricing change orchestration: quick-path approvals and SQ readiness checklist
creator: Ariana Patel
description: Objective: Define a lightweight orchestrated approval path ("quick-path") for common low-risk pricing actions (seat addons, volume credits < 15%, trial extensions) that reduces friction for Sales while maintaining auditability and SQ readiness for enterprise customers. Scope includes: mapping existing approval gates, designing the quick-path criteria, updating the pricebook metadata for automated gating, creating an SQ (security questionnaire) checklist for pricing exceptions, and a small Console UI change to surface why a request was auto-approved vs escalated. Success metrics: (1) reduce average approval turnaround for eligible requests from 48h to <4h, (2) maintain audit trail completeness for 100% of quick-path approvals, (3) pass 3 pilot enterprise SQ reviews without additional follow-ups on pricing questions. Deliverables: quick-path decision matrix, updated pricebook CSV template, PRD for Console status UX, SQ checklist for Sales/CS, rollout plan and pilot with two AE pods.
acceptance_criteria: Decision matrix documented and reviewed by Sales, Legal, and Finance
Pricebook schema updated with quick-path flags and sample ingest file validated in staging
SQ checklist completed and linked from the pricing request form
Console UI mockups reviewed and sign-off from Design and PM
Pilot executed with two AE pods and metrics captured (turnaround time, audit completeness)
